text: けっこう　おおい　らしいわ！

patterns.name: 〜らしい
patterns.explanation: らしい says the speaker heard this from someone else and isn't stating it firsthand. おおい らしい = 'apparently there are a lot'.

patterns.name: 〜わ
patterns.explanation: わ at the end is a soft, feminine way to finish a sentence and adds no meaning of its own. らしいわ = 'so it seems!'.
